card.name: Words before an expected abstract noun
card.fires_on: Small connecting or modifying words (his, its, usual, similar, of, in) in older literary or essay prose, right before a noun like abode, guard, ability, or tastes. It fires on the word that sets up the noun, not on the noun itself.

modes.label: Possessive or adjective before noun
modes.description: A possessive or descriptive word such as his, its, usual, similar, or good that is followed by an abstract noun.
